regions.purpose: Marks the surface as an uncommitted draft and holds the dismiss affordances. In add-to-collection mode it carries both Go back (dismiss this sheet, return to MapOverview-in-add-mode) and Cancel adding (kill the whole flow); in browse mode it carries only Close.
Shows the candidate's raw coordinates and holds the keep-as-is and add-to-collection affordances.
The nearby real places resolution offered for the dropped point, browsable as a list.

shows: category or address from cachedMetadata, when the provider supplied it

lists.emptyState: When resolution returns no nearby places — or has not run yet — the region says so; the coordinates can still be kept as-is via Keep coordinates only.
